modules.purpose: Coordinate workspace identity, adapters, deterministic reads, legacy/manual relay and composition of bounded runtime capabilities.
invariants: Workspace identity/authority remains fail-closed.
Runtime composition does not widen effect authority.
Deterministic reads and provider routing remain explicit.

modules.purpose: Bind, preview, approve, execute and verify external effects without allowing cognition to widen authority.
invariants: Effects remain approval-bound to exact workspace and staged provider state.
Pending approvals are durably persisted before they are exposed to the operator.
Restarted approvals are re-previewed and re-hashed against current reality before execution.
Approval consumption is durable before effect execution so a crash cannot leave a replayable approved effect.
Verified effects are never replayed merely to recover later cognition.

modules.purpose: Drive bounded module work through fresh cognition, durable READ continuation, approval-bound effects and architecture repair.
invariants: Every module cognition step is fresh.
READ results recompile into durable continuation context.
Verified-effect continuation state is persisted before post-effect cognition and survives Bob restart.
Post-effect cognition resume cannot replay an already-verified effect.
Oversized modules cannot claim DONE before measured cap compliance.

modules.purpose: Define and parse the bounded machine-readable BOB message protocol.
invariants: Protocol messages never expand authority.

modules.purpose: Represent cognition-bounded modules, enforce the 15k cap and compile source-grounded fresh cognition packets.
invariants: Every module remains <=15000 measured tokens.
One cognition question uses one fresh ChatGPT conversation.
GitHub remains implementation truth.

modules.purpose: Persist repository-scoped bounded runs, cognition correlation, dependencies, leases and serialized integration state.
invariants: At most 3 active Bob runs occupy worker slots per repository ledger.
Ledger repository identity and canonical ref are durable and fail closed on mismatch.
One run has at most one RUNNING cognition.
Every cognition has stable run_id/cognition_id/request_id correlation.
Integration is FIFO, single-owner per repo and stale candidates require rebase/reverification.
PARKED selfdev runs hold neither worker slots nor semantic leases and can resume only through ordinary queue arbitration.
Ledger state never grants effect authority or performs promotion.

modules.purpose: Isolate mutating Bob runs in dedicated local Git branches/worktrees and verify integration ancestry without performing promotion.
invariants: Coordinator verifies local Git origin and bound canonical ref before opening repository state.
Every active mutating run has an isolated branch/worktree.
Conflicting semantic leases cannot mutate concurrently.
Worktree coordination never merges, pushes, force-pushes or deletes branches.
Integrated state is recorded only after verified candidate ancestry is observed in canonical state.

modules.purpose: Persist repo-bound self-development backlog and restart-safe lifecycle state without owning execution or promotion.
invariants: Queue state is bound to exact repository identity and canonical ref.
At most one self-development item is ACTIVE in V1.
ACTIVE work becomes INTERRUPTED on restart instead of being replayed.
Bound execution work must be reconciled before a self-development item is requeued.
Self-development state never grants effect authority or performs promotion.

modules.purpose: Bind self-development intent to existing repo-scoped execution runs/worktrees with explicit restart reconciliation and no promotion authority.
invariants: Every claimed item binds at most one lane=selfdev execution run with matching selfdev_item_id authority metadata.
Claim requires an explicit base ref and copies semantic leases into the existing repository coordinator.
Restart reconciliation resumes the same live run without incrementing attempt_count or creating a duplicate run.
Ambiguous or conflicting queue/run bindings fail closed.
Bound items can finish only after execution is terminal; QUALIFIED requires explicit verification and a preserved cancelled branch receipt.
Self-development execution never integrates or promotes a candidate and records promotion_authority=NONE.

modules.purpose: Own reversible self-development checkpoints/discard and safe interactive-first orchestration without canonical promotion.
invariants: Interactive pre-emption requires a clean durable checkpoint before a selfdev lease is parked.
Dirty or cognition-busy selfdev work fails closed and keeps its lease instead of being silently discarded.
Checkpoint/revert/discard operate only on the exact bound Bob-owned selfdev run worktree and never on canonical checkout state.
Revert restores an exact same-run checkpoint and verifies resulting HEAD plus clean worktree state.
Discard restores the isolated run to its base SHA, cancels execution, removes only its worktree and records promotion_authority=NONE.
Terminal interactive work may resume the exact parked selfdev run through ordinary lease/capacity arbitration.

modules.purpose: Persist exact self-development candidate review proposals and stale-state revalidation without performing canonical promotion.
invariants: Promotion proposals require QUALIFIED self-development with exact no-promotion run/branch/head receipts.
Candidate head, qualification evidence and current canonical SHA are freshly revalidated before approval.
Operator approval binds an exact candidate/canonical pair and records merge_authority=NONE.
Moved candidates or canonical ancestry changes fail closed as stale or rebase/reverify required.
The promotion gate never merges, pushes, opens PRs, changes integration state or widens provider authority.

modules.purpose: Own durable bounded wall-clock work-campaign scope, deadlines, admission and execution-run bindings without duplicating repository execution authority.
invariants: Campaign start requires exact configured local repository bindings for every target workspace.
A wall-clock deadline closes new run admission but never asynchronously kills a nonterminal run mid-step.
Campaign runs reuse existing repository coordinators, semantic leases, isolated worktrees and per-repository capacity.
Restart reconciliation may adopt exact lane=campaign runs bound by campaign_id without duplicating execution.
Campaign state and runs record promotion_authority=NONE and auto_merge=false.
Campaign control never merges, pushes, promotes, widens provider authority or invents a second execution scheduler.

modules.purpose: Own durable lifecycle, ports, logs and bounded cleanup for explicit Bob Local child processes.
invariants: Only explicitly registered Bob-owned process identities may be stopped automatically.
PID reuse fails closed through creation-time identity.
Long-lived output goes to bounded-tail file logs rather than unbounded RDC stdout.
Port collisions block startup and never trigger killing an unknown process.
Recovery is bounded; V1 has no automatic infinite restart loop.
